headline_marked: [[Curacao goalkeeper makes 15 saves]] to hold powerful Ecuador to a goalless draw, setting a new World Cup record
headline: Curacao goalkeeper makes 15 saves to hold powerful Ecuador to a goalless draw, setting a new World Cup record
summary: Eloy Room's heroic performance secured a historic point for the Caribbean island nation, marking their first-ever World Cup point against a formidable Latin American opponent.
details: Caribbean island nation Curacao secured a historic goalless draw against powerful Latin American team Ecuador at Children's Mercy Park in Kansas City. The incredible feat, earning them a memorable World Cup point, was largely due to the heroic performance of their goalkeeper, Eloy Room.

Throughout the match, Ecuador's forwards launched relentless attacks, breaking through Curacao's defense with powerful shots. However, Eloy Room stood as an impenetrable wall beneath the goalpost, thwarting every attempt.

His exceptional agility, precise positioning, and dazzling dives repeatedly shattered Ecuador's offensive efforts. Room incredibly saved 15 definite goals during the game, creating a new epic in football history.

This marks the highest number of saves by a goalkeeper in a 90-minute World Cup match without extra time since 1966. The all-time World Cup record for most saves in a single match, including extra time, remains 16 saves by former US goalkeeper Tim Howard against Belgium in 2014.
caption:
Curacao's goalkeeper Eloy Room made an astonishing 15 saves against Ecuador, securing a historic goalless draw. This performance set a new World Cup record for saves in a 90-minute match since 1966.

headline_marked: At 46, [[Ronaldinho set for surprise return]] with Italian third-tier club
headline: At 46, Ronaldinho set for surprise return with Italian third-tier club
summary: The former Ballon d'Or and World Cup winner is reportedly signing with Ravenna, ending a retirement that began in 2015.
details: Former Ballon d'Or and World Cup winner Ronaldinho is set to come out of retirement at age 46 to play for Ravenna in the Italian third tier, according to reports from Gazzetta dello Sport.
The sports daily reported that Ronaldinho was scheduled to sign a deal in Miami on Tuesday, as he was already in the United States.
A source close to the deal confirmed the news to AFP, and Ronaldinho expressed his excitement about returning to the pitch and bringing joy to the club.
However, Ravenna vice-president Ariedo Braida told Italian media that the signing is more of a marketing ploy than a squad-building move, suggesting the star may not actually play.
Braida noted that while Ronaldinho is a magical player and will be registered, his actual participation in matches at 46 depends on several factors.
Ronaldinho has not played professional football since a brief two-month stint at Fluminense in 2015.
caption:
Ronaldinho is coming back! The 46-year-old legend is set to return to professional football with an Italian third-tier club.

Former Ballon d'Or and World Cup winner Ronaldinho is set to come out of retirement at age 46 to play for Ravenna in the Italian third tier, according to reports from Gazzetta dello Sport.

The sports daily reported that Ronaldinho was scheduled to sign a deal in Miami on Tuesday, as he was already in the United States.

A source close to the deal confirmed the news to AFP, and Ronaldinho expressed his excitement about returning to the pitch and bringing joy to the club.

However, Ravenna vice-president Ariedo Braida told Italian media that the signing is more of a marketing ploy than a squad-building move, suggesting the star may not actually play.

Braida noted that while Ronaldinho is a magical player and will be registered, his actual participation in matches at 46 depends on several factors.

Ronaldinho has not played professional football since a brief two-month stint at Fluminense in 2015.
